en:
Oh, Shuichi! If you have free time, would you
like to spend it with me?

My goodness... Kokichi makes the most
insensitive remarks about robots...

That boy is in desperate need of a proper
education...
Have you come to extend an invitation?

Shuichi! Let's escape this ridiculous school
someday!
Spend time together

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>What would you like to do with K1-B0?
Spend time together
Go on a date
Never mind

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>What would you like to do with K1-B0?

Actually, I wanted to get your opinion on my
design.

Should the professor alter my appearance
the next time he remodels me?

I happen to like my design, but I want to hear
what others think of it as well.

<CLT=cltMIND>We spent some time talking about whether
or not Keebo should change his design.

If I'm ever tasked with raising a child, I will
make sure he does not end up like Kokichi.

A tiny Kokichi would damage my delicate
machinery within a week's time...

<CLT=cltMIND>We spent some time talking about
a child model for Keebo.

Shuichi, do you believe in metaphysical
concepts, such as destiny and fate?

As a product of science, I'm interested to see
how others feel about such subjects.

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time talking to Keebo, the
epitome of science, about unscientific things.
I'm confident that we'll escape this place!

Let's show Monokuma that we're more than
just his playthings!

<CLT=cltMIND>We spent some time talking about
how we could escape.
<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo and I grew a little closer today.
